concerns.text: T009 (validate_graph.py) is placed in Phase 2 (Foundational) but is listed as a separate task after T004-T008. FR-008 requires graph validation 'before analysis'. If T009 fails, downstream tasks (T012-T018) in Phase 3 rely on an invalid graph. The task order implies T009 is a standalone step, but the dependency logic requires it to be a gating condition or integrated into T006 (preprocess) to ensure Phase 3 cannot start on bad data. Currently, the flow allows T012 to theoretically start if T009 is skipped or delayed, violating the 'Producer before Consumer' rule for the 'valid graph' artifact.

T014 and T015 (US1) depend on the 'inflection point' and 'risk flags' which require statistical significance (p < 0.05) per SC-001. However, the statistical analysis tasks (T021-T026) are in Phase 4 (US2). T014/T015 attempt to consume statistical results (significance) before the producer (US2 survival/chi-squared tasks) exists. This creates a circular dependency or forces T014 to use raw percentages only, violating SC-001's requirement for statistical significance in the inflection point definition.

T017 (US1) requires computing 'independent topological complexity metrics' (FR-009) for each route. T005 (Phase 2) computes 'topological complexity metrics' but is described as building a 'local adjacency graph' and computing metrics generally. T017 implies a per-route calculation needed for the evaluation. If T005 only produces global graph metrics, T017 is a consumer of an artifact that doesn't exist in the required form. T005 must be explicitly defined to output per-route metrics, or T017 must be moved to Phase 2 or explicitly depend on a new task.

T005 is marked [P] (parallel-safe) but depends on T004 (download) and likely T006 (preprocess) to have the data available to build the graph. While T005 and T006 might be parallel if they read from the same raw source, T005's description 'build the local adjacency graph from training data' implies it needs the filtered/processed data from T006. If T005 runs before T006, it builds a graph on unfiltered data, violating the data flow. The [P] tag is risky without explicit dependency clarification.
